EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 – Powerful 16W Portable Audio with Bluetooth 5.3

The EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 is designed for users who demand powerful sound, long battery life, and modern connectivity in a compact portable speaker. Equipped with Bluetooth Version 5.3 and a robust 16 W RMS total output (8 W x 2), this speaker delivers clear, immersive audio for both indoor and outdoor use. Whether you are streaming music at home, hosting a small gathering, or enjoying entertainment on the go, the EnBar Plus speaker ensures stable performance and impressive sound clarity.

Built with dual 5.2 cm x 2 speaker drivers, the EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 produces balanced bass, crisp mids, and detailed highs. The advanced driver configuration enhances sound dispersion, making it ideal for music lovers, casual listeners, and professional usage alike. With its optimized acoustic design, this portable Bluetooth speaker offers distortion-free audio even at higher volumes.

Advanced Bluetooth 5.3 for Seamless Wireless Connectivity

Featuring the latest Bluetooth Version 5.3, the EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 provides faster pairing, improved signal stability, and reduced power consumption. Enjoy uninterrupted wireless audio streaming from smartphones, tablets, laptops, and other Bluetooth-enabled devices. The extended wireless range ensures smooth connectivity, making it a reliable wireless speaker for everyday use.

Long-Lasting Battery Performance

Powered by a 1200 mAh battery capacity, the EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 delivers an impressive working time of about 12 hours on a single charge*. This makes it a dependable choice for long listening sessions, outdoor trips, travel, or extended meetings. The energy-efficient design ensures consistent playback without frequent recharging.

Convenient Charging and Multiple Input Options

The speaker is equipped with a modern Type-C charging input port, allowing faster and more reliable charging compared to traditional ports. In addition to wireless streaming, the USB Input feature enables direct playback from USB drives, offering flexibility for users who prefer offline music sources. The dedicated On/Off switch provides ease of operation and helps conserve battery life when not in use.

Compact, Durable, and Easy to Use

Designed for portability and durability, the EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 features a compact build that fits easily into bags or backpacks. Its sturdy construction ensures long-term performance, making it suitable for daily use, travel, and outdoor environments. The intuitive control layout allows users to manage playback and power functions effortlessly.

Ideal for Multiple Use Cases

Whether you need a portable Bluetooth speaker for home entertainment, office use, travel, or gifting, the EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 meets diverse requirements. Its combination of powerful audio output, modern Bluetooth technology, and long battery life makes it a preferred choice in the portable speaker category.

Key Features of EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105

  • Model: EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105
  • Bluetooth Version: 5.3 for stable and fast connectivity
  • Total Output: 16 W RMS (8 W x 2)
  • Speaker Driver: 5.2 cm x 2 for enhanced sound clarity
  • Battery Capacity: 1200 mAh
  • Working Time*: About 12 hours on a single charge
  • Charging Port: Type-C charging input port
  • Additional Input: USB Input support
  • Power Control: Dedicated On/Off switch

Why Choose EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105?

The EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 stands out due to its balanced combination of performance, portability, and reliability. With high-quality audio output, efficient battery usage, and versatile connectivity options, this wireless speaker is optimized for users seeking value and durability. Its SEO-friendly design and user-focused features make it a strong contender among portable Bluetooth speakers in its segment.

Upgrade your audio experience with the EnBar Plus Bluetooth Speaker EVM-BTS-105 and enjoy powerful sound, extended playtime, and modern wireless convenience wherever you go.
